## [Opportunities to Collaborate]{.section-heading}

::: {.collab-intro}
Whether you are exploring a new business model, validating an innovation idea, building analytics capabilities, or designing an evidence-based entrepreneurship program — we help you structure the problem, access the right methods, and translate results into practice.
:::

::: {.collab-grid}

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa flask >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Applied Research Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We partner on clearly defined research questions in entrepreneurship and innovation — typically with measurable outcomes, structured data collection, and rigorous analysis.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa brain >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Data Science & AI Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We support analytics and AI work around innovation challenges, including machine learning, natural language processing, experimentation, and data-driven decision support.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa graduation-cap >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Company-Linked Theses]{.collab-card__title}

[We supervise empirical theses with external partners when the topic fits our profile and offers a feasible research design (e.g., existing data, interviews, surveys, experiments).]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa chalkboard-user >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Workshops & Trainings]{.collab-card__title}

[Hands-on formats for teams on topics such as startup engineering, business model innovation, experimentation, and data-driven innovation work.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa microphone >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Talks & Guest Lectures]{.collab-card__title}

[Keynotes, panels, and guest sessions for internal events, conferences, and entrepreneurship education formats.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

::: {.collab-card}
[{{< fa handshake >}}]{.collab-card__icon}

[Consortia & Funded Projects]{.collab-card__title}

[We join or initiate multi-partner projects (e.g., university–industry–startup collaborations) when there is a strong research contribution and an implementation pathway.]{.collab-card__desc}
:::

:::

::: {.collab-steps}

### How to Get Started

1. **Send a short description** of your goal, context, and preferred collaboration format.
2. **We do a quick fit check** and propose a collaboration setup.
3. **Scoping call:** align on question, methods, timeline, data access, and outputs.
4. **Project start:** define responsibilities, milestones, and communication.

:::

:::
:::
